name: bean-ai-worker-bundles
description: Build-time dependencies for the BEAN browser AI worker bundles (public/workers/*.js, built by scripts/build-workers.mjs). Deliberately NESTED: the heavy browser runtimes (@mlc-ai/web-llm, @huggingface/transformers, onnxruntime-web) are never installed into the app's own node_modules — their presence measurably OOM-kills the Turbopack production build in memory-constrained environments, and the app graph never imports them (only the prebuilt, self-hosted worker bundles do).
